newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end firmer, off early highs.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end firmer, off early highs.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended firmer across the board on Wednesday, but off early highs as private investors' short-covering lost steam later in the day, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.3 yen to 0.9 yen per kg higher. Benchmark February was 0.3 yen firmer at 140.7 yen.
After opening firmer, prices moved within relatively narrow ranges as private investors generally retreated to the sidelines ahead of the spot expiry on September 24.
An increase in Japan's rubber stocks announced in the afternoon, also helped erode early gains, they said.
